title: C4ncer - Inappropiate Username

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body: We don't feel as though this username is inappropriate. We understand it's a terrible illness that kills millions of people each year, but the word itself is fine.

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body: Can you tell me how 'Poosydon' is inappropiate and 'C4ncer' and 'FatLesbian' are appropriate?
replies.body_tagged: Can you tell me how 'Poosydon' is inappropiate and 'C4ncer' and 'FatLesbian' are appropriate?

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
Furthermore, when this player kills somebody, it says that Cancer killed them. Cancer is not something to joke about. The killed person could've been affected by cancer very recently.

This is also misleading because when this player dies,  someone could think that cancer was defeated!

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
Poosydon was a name that makes fun of Posighdun, basically calling him a "pussy". I don't think there's really a direct comparison between this name and the others.

In regard to the other two now. I don't see what's inappropriate about a person's sexual orientation. Adding on the word "fat" to the name was okay as well, since it wasn't saying that all lesbians are fat, or anything like that. It would be like having the name "FatAussie" - it's not saying all Aussies are fat, just the one.

C4ncer is very much the same. Cancer isn't something that's inappropriate. The word itself often is used inappropriately (people calling others "cancer" or making jokes about it, etc). I also doubt that anyone who's sees C4ncer die in chat is going to assume that means cancer had been cured.

I'm sure that most people that play on the server has been affected by cancer in one way or another. However, I don't think we can call the name inappropriate based off of just that. If someone had the name "Death" or "Funeral", it wouldn't make sense to ban them either just because someone on the server may have had a family member die recently.
